notes: Registers the synthetic fixture world edge-to-edge on the canvas. Uses the 'equirectangular' projection deliberately: after the whole-world satellite render was de-registered in S2 that code path lost its only production consumer, and an untested branch in a reprojection module is exactly the kind of thing that rots silently. The four corners fix the placement; the two interior points are redundant with them by construction, so fit_parametric's reported residual stays a real conditioning check rather than a fitted-away one.
